title: Whole-brain annotation and multi-connectome cell typing of Drosophila
authors: Schlegel, P., Yin, Y., Bates, A. S., Dorkenwald, S., Eichler, K., et al.
relevant_section: Comprehensive cell-type annotations and hierarchical superclass taxonomy for 211,577 MaleCNS neurons.
notes: Primary reference for MaleCNS v1.0 connectome annotations, body IDs, neurotransmitter predictions, and cell types.

title: The network organization of the Drosophila connectome: descending neurons
authors: Namiki, S., Dickinson, M. H., Wong, A. M., Korff, W., Card, G. M.
relevant_section: Table 1 & Figure 3: Identification of DNp01 as the Giant Fiber (GF) descending neuron driving jump-and-flight escape.
notes: Establishes systematic descending neuron nomenclature and structural connectivity of DNp01 to motor target TTMn.

title: The comprehensive connectome of a neural substrate for 'ON' motion detection in Drosophila
authors: Takemura, S. Y., Nern, A., Chklovskii, D. B., Scheffer, L. K., et al.
relevant_section: Synaptic connectome connecting medulla intrinsic (Mi1) and transmedullary (Tm3) neurons onto direction-selective T4 dendrites.
notes: Key anatomical ground truth establishing the elementary motion detector (EMD) circuit in the Drosophila optic lobe.

title: Common principles of visual motion detection
relevant_section: Figure 2: Paralleled ON (T4) and OFF (T5) pathways computing directional motion across visual space.
notes: Theoretical and anatomical foundation distinguishing directional motion processing subtypes T4a-d and T5a-d.

title: Visually mediated motor planning in the escape response of Drosophila
relevant_section: Behavioral initiation of rapid escape jumps in response to expanding dark looming disks, mediated by lobula columnar cells (LC4).
notes: Links sensory stimulus (optical loom) to escape motor action via lobula columnar projection neurons and descending pathways.

title: Complete connectomic reconstruction of olfactory projection neurons in the fly brain
authors: Bates, A. S., Schlegel, P., Roberts, R. J., Drummond, N., Tamimi, I. F., et al.
relevant_section: Section on uniglomerular and multiglomerular projection neuron morphologies and connectivity in the antennal lobe.
notes: Reference for olfactory glomerular cell typing and projection neuron connections to mushroom body calyx and lateral horn.
